description: This file is a source code file written in C for a memory debugging module within the cURL project. It provides debugging, logging, and memory management functions that track allocations, deallocations, and socket operations for debugging purposes.

methods.name: void curl_dbg_memdebug(const char * logname)
methods.description: Sets the log file name for memory debugging logs.

methods.name: void curl_dbg_memlimit(long limit)
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of memory allocations allowed.

methods.name: ALLOC_FUNC void * curl_dbg_malloc(size_t wantedsize,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Allocates memory with debugging hooks to log the allocation.

methods.name: ALLOC_FUNC void * curl_dbg_calloc(size_t wanted_elements,size_t wanted_size,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Allocates cleared memory with debugging hooks.

methods.name: ALLOC_FUNC char * curl_dbg_strdup(const char * str,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Duplicates a string with debugging log.

methods.name: ALLOC_FUNC wchar_t * curl_dbg_wcsdup(const wchar_t * str,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Duplicates a wide character string with debugging log (Windows only).

methods.name: void * curl_dbg_realloc(void * ptr,size_t wantedsize,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Reallocates memory with debugging hooks.

methods.name: void curl_dbg_free(void * ptr,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Frees memory with debugging hooks.

methods.name: curl_socket_t curl_dbg_socket(int domain,int type,int protocol,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Creates a socket with debugging log.

methods.name: SEND_TYPE_RETV curl_dbg_send(SEND_TYPE_ARG1 sockfd,SEND_QUAL_ARG2 SEND_TYPE_ARG2 buf,SEND_TYPE_ARG3 len,SEND_TYPE_ARG4 flags,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Sends data over a socket with debugging log.

methods.name: RECV_TYPE_RETV curl_dbg_recv(RECV_TYPE_ARG1 sockfd,RECV_TYPE_ARG2 buf,RECV_TYPE_ARG3 len,RECV_TYPE_ARG4 flags,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Receives data over a socket with debugging log.

methods.name: int curl_dbg_socketpair(int domain,int type,int protocol,curl_socket_t socket_vector[2],int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Creates a socket pair with debugging log.

methods.name: curl_socket_t curl_dbg_accept(curl_socket_t s,void * saddr,void * saddrlen,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Accepts a socket connection with debugging log.

methods.name: void curl_dbg_mark_sclose(curl_socket_t sockfd,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Logs the closure of a socket.

methods.name: int curl_dbg_sclose(curl_socket_t sockfd,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Closes a socket with debugging log.

methods.name: ALLOC_FUNC FILE * curl_dbg_fopen(const char * file,const char * mode,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Opens a file with debugging log.

methods.name: ALLOC_FUNC FILE * curl_dbg_fdopen(int filedes,const char * mode,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Associates a stream with a file descriptor with debugging log.

methods.name: int curl_dbg_fclose(FILE * file,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: Closes a file stream with debugging log.

methods.name: void curl_dbg_log(const char * format,...)
methods.description: Writes a formatted log line to the debug log file.

methods.name: bool countcheck(const char * func,int line,const char * source)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: void curl_dbg_cleanup(void)
methods.description: unavailable
